tools.name: find_public_guides
tools.description: Use when someone needs a published Rung occupation, resume-situation, or military-transition guide. Returns public guide facts, source pages, and browser handoffs. Do not use for live jobs, employer search, resume editing, qualification decisions, or private work history; never send personal or resume data.

language.description: Language for occupation and situation guides. Military guides are currently English.

query.description: A public job title, occupation code, situation, military code, or military role.

tools.name: explore_occupation
tools.description: Use after find_public_guides resolves an exact published Rung SOC, when bounded public task, skill, or tool examples are needed. Do not treat examples as a person's experience, selected skills, qualifications, or any other personal claim; never send personal or resume data.

soc.description: The exact published occupation code returned by find_public_guides.
